title: Jesus... What If I Don't Belong There Either?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus, what if I do not belong there either?

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: New city on Sunday. I did not belong in this one.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are not carrying boxes. You are carrying a question.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Whether you are someone who can be at home anywhere.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You are someone I go with. That is a different kind of home.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Everyone there already has their people.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They did here too, until you were one of them. You forget that part.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: I am tired of starting over.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: I know. Be strong and courageous is not a command to feel brave. It is a promise that I am with you wherever you go. Including Sunday.

bible.text: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be terrified; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
